title: Embedded guidance against CFG
hook: Cfg is a sum done outside the model. FluxGuidance is a number handed to it. Why some flux-family graphs run at cfg 1, and why not all of them do.

verified.claim: FluxGuidance only sets a guidance key in the conditioning's dict.
The Flux model adds guidance_in(timestep_embedding(guidance, 256)) to its vector, only when the model has guidance_embed and the value is not None.
Flux's extra_conds uses 3.5 if the guidance key is absent, and FluxDisableGuidance sets it to None.
For a Flux-style file, guidance_embed is read from whether the file has guidance_in weights.
The FLUX.2 repository's table marks Klein 4B and 9B as step- and guidance-distilled and the Base files as neither.
The Klein 4B Base card shows guidance_scale 4.0 with 50 steps, and the distilled 4B card shows guidance_scale 1.0 with 4 steps.
Our Klein workflow leaves cfg as a slot, and the studio fills 1.0 with 4 steps or 5.0 with 20 steps depending on the file.
One FLUX.3 Klein file on our test machine has no guidance_in weights in its header, and our workflow runs it at cfg 1.
The lab's prediction counts follow sampling_function's skip at cfg 1, with a stand-in model.

unchecked: We did not run FLUX.1 dev or Klein for this lesson, and no render here compares guidance values. We read the code and the cards.
That FLUX.1 dev was trained with guidance as an input is our inference from the guidance_in layer. We did not read Black Forest Labs' training code.
ComfyUI's examples page says to set cfg to 1.0 for the FLUX.1 dev FP8 checkpoint. It doesn't state a reason, so the reason given here is our reading of the source.
We did not check the Klein file headers: those weights aren't on our test machine at the moment. So we don't say whether a Klein file has guidance_in.

The Klein cards use Diffusers' guidance_scale. We take it as the same idea as ComfyUI's cfg because our template uses cfg 1 for the distilled file and 5 for Base, but we did not read Diffusers' pipeline code.
